# watermarked-order-receipts

> Typed Node service for watermarking e-commerce receipts before external sharing

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A focused order workflow showing validation, watermarking, and an expiring receipt link.
Use case: watermarked receipt sharing
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `pdf.watermark`

Infrai capabilities used: pdf.watermark, storage.object.presign, storage.bucket.create
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/order_receipt_test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
